## Earlier work

Postdoctoral work at the National Severe Storms Laboratory with David Stensrud and Dave Turner: observing system simulation experiments for a winter storm modeled on January 2008 and a spring convective outbreak modeled on May 24, 2011.

Numerical methods for weather prediction, with Catherine Mavriplis, Louis Wicker and Dustin Williams: finite difference, discontinuous Galerkin and spectral difference schemes compared on advection, Burgers and acoustic-advection problems. Presented at ICCS 2009 and ICOSAHOM 2009.
